summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi TER 2x Daily ETF (TERC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The Corgi TER 2x Daily ETF (the Fund) seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the publicly-traded common stock of Teradyne, Inc. (NASDAQ: TER) (Teradyne or the Underlying Security). TERC was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
